direct_obligations.name: Compact smooth connected incidence surface
direct_obligations.check: Projective incidence is compact; two displayed exceptional charts are smooth and the biholomorphic connected dense complement proves connectedness.

direct_obligations.name: Bundle charts and saturation
direct_obligations.check: tprime=1/t,wprime=t w identify O(-1); its norm squared equals the affine coordinate radius squared and affine balls have precisely the model tubes as preimages.

direct_obligations.name: Covariant tensor transformation
direct_obligations.check: The covariant differential multiplies by t and lambda divides by |t|^2, giving a global smooth rank-one tensor.

direct_obligations.name: Positive model
direct_obligations.check: k is positive on vertical vectors and zero on TE; the base tensor is positive on projected nonzero vectors, so their sum is positive.

direct_obligations.name: Exact inner global extension
direct_obligations.check: A cutoff in a larger bundle tube and convex combination with any global Hermitian metric give the claimed exact inner model.

direct_obligations.name: Layer smoothness and gluing
direct_obligations.check: f_j is smooth in r^2, positive with lower bound epsilon_j^2, and identically one for r>=2 epsilon_j^2; the modified metrics glue smoothly.

direct_obligations.name: Core convergence
direct_obligations.check: The shrinking layer eventually misses every compact regular core, where equality with g_* is exact.

direct_obligations.name: Exact volume
direct_obligations.check: Both rank-one Hermitian forms square to zero; reciprocal coefficients preserve their mixed product and hence the global volume form.

direct_obligations.name: Curve upper bound and area
direct_obligations.check: The restriction is epsilon_j^2 h<=h; its area is epsilon_j^2.

direct_obligations.name: Unit radial speed
direct_obligations.check: The base coordinate is constant and k has squared speed one on a unit fiber ray.

direct_obligations.name: Uniform integrable radial bound
direct_obligations.check: Within the layer speed squared <=epsilon_j^-2<=2/s; outside it speed squared is one<=2/s for s<delta_0<1.

direct_obligations.name: Direct radial length
direct_obligations.check: The layer portion has length <=2 epsilon_j; the remaining portion has length <=r.

direct_obligations.name: Source intrinsic diameter
direct_obligations.check: Two radial segments and the zero-section path lie in U_delta and give 2 delta+epsilon_j(4+diam_h E).

direct_obligations.name: Order of limits
direct_obligations.check: First epsilon_j tends to zero with delta fixed, then delta tends to zero.

direct_obligations.name: Global punctured lower distance
direct_obligations.check: Any target punctured path lifts to a regular source path with identical length; its length is at least the global smooth g_* distance between lifted endpoints.

direct_obligations.name: Positive persistent puncture diameter
direct_obligations.check: Two fiber sequences approach distinct exceptional points at positive g_* distance; every fixed small target ball contains arbitrarily deep members, so its supremum diameter is at least that distance.

direct_obligations.name: Scope
direct_obligations.check: Only one direction of nonimplication for general Hermitian metrics with fixed volume is proved; no specified-background PDE, converse, completion/GH, novelty or original closure is claimed.
